fields.name: date_time
fields.description: Hourly timestamp of the traffic count observation.
fields.null_behavior: Mandatory. Rows with unparseable timestamps are dropped.

fields.name: traffic_volume
fields.description: Westbound hourly traffic volume recorded at ATR 301 station.
fields.null_behavior: Never silently converted to zero. Valid range: 0 to 8000.

fields.name: temp
fields.description: Average hourly air temperature in Kelvin.
fields.null_behavior: Records with sensor failure (0.0 K = absolute zero anomaly) are filtered/corrected.

fields.name: rain_1h
fields.description: Rain accumulation in the hour before the observation.
fields.null_behavior: Defaults to 0.0 mm if dry. Anomalous gauge spikes (>500mm sensor errors) are audited.

fields.name: snow_1h
fields.description: Snow accumulation in the preceding hour.

fields.name: clouds_all
fields.description: Cloud coverage percentage (0% = completely clear, 100% = overcast).

fields.name: weather_main
fields.description: High-level weather category: Clear, Clouds, Rain, Snow, Drizzle, Mist, Fog, Thunderstorm, Haze, Squall, Smoke.

fields.name: weather_description
fields.description: Detailed text description of current weather state.

fields.name: holiday
fields.description: US National holiday or special event name if the day is a recognized holiday.
fields.null_behavior: Normalized to 'None' for regular days instead of ambiguous nulls.

fields.name: is_holiday
fields.description: Derived indicator: true if the day is an observed holiday, false otherwise.

fields.name: day_of_week
fields.description: ISO weekday index extracted from date_time.

fields.name: is_weekend
fields.description: True if day_of_week >= 5 (Saturday or Sunday), false otherwise.

fields.name: congestion_category
fields.description: Documented historical traffic volume classification: Low (<1500 veh/h), Moderate (1500-3499 veh/h), Heavy (3500-4999 veh/h), Severe (>=5000 veh/h).
fields.null_behavior: Derived deterministically based on volume thresholds.
